name: comp-76
title: Read-Only Textarea
blurb: Read-only textarea with muted background to indicate non-editable state.
description: A textarea with readOnly attribute applied and CSS read-only pseudo-class styling to visually indicate the field cannot be edited but content can be copied.
use_when: Displaying non-editable text like confirmation messages, logs, or reference data.
avoid_when: When the field needs to be interactive or editable by users.
a11y: readOnly attribute is properly set; users can still focus and copy text.
